correctness.rationale: The exact 96-facet complex gives f=(16,112,192,96). A cotree presentation has 97 cycle generators. A nonzero integral cocycle annihilates all 192 facial relations, while a fixed 96-by-96 minor has determinant 1, proving H1 is torsion-free of rank one. Exhaustion of all graph triangles gives 144 null nonfacial triangles and 134 primitive generators, split 85/49 by the displayed orientation.
